title: Provider Profiles
description: View and edit provider profiles. Use the row menu to connect Stripe payouts.

help.title: About Provider profiles
help.overview: A provider profile is the marketplace seller record for a user: bio, skills, and rating, plus Stripe Connect fields for payouts. Connect onboarding and status refresh are actions on the current user's profile.

sections.title: Profile fields
items: Provider is the user this profile belongs to.
Bio and skills describe the seller on the storefront.
Rating summarizes feedback from completed work.

sections.title: Stripe Connect
items: Create account link — starts or resumes Express onboarding for the signed-in user's profile and returns a URL to open.
Refresh account status — pulls charges/payouts/details flags from Stripe onto the profile.
Use the row menu on this page for Connect when those actions are available.
Soft-deleted profiles are not used for live Connect flows.
sections.body: Payout setup needs the payment gateway configured and Connect return/refresh URLs set for the company.
